name: Can-Am X3 Turbo RR - 2 Seater
blurb: The RR badge means more boost and stiffer damping. Experienced drivers only.

durations.label: 30 minutes
durations.blurb: The lowest commitment. Enough to learn the controls and cross a few dune faces on the Can-Am X3 Turbo RR 2-Seater.

durations.label: 1 hour
durations.blurb: The sweet spot for most riders. Time to settle into the Can-Am X3 Turbo RR 2-Seater and get a proper run at the red dunes.

durations.label: 2 hours
durations.blurb: A longer route with more varied terrain and photo stops, for riders already comfortable on the Can-Am X3 Turbo RR 2-Seater.

heroPhoto.alt: Red and white Can-Am Maverick X3 X RS turbo two seater on Dubai desert sand
